description: Read the workspace's current credit balance, returned as `balance`. One credit is one photo from generate_background or one preview from create_background or refine_background; hide_license_plates uses none. Call it before a batch to check there are enough credits, or after an insufficient-credits error. Read-only and free; takes no parameters. It does not show plans or prices: when the balance is too low, use list_plans, then create_checkout (no subscription yet) or change_plan (existing subscription).
name: get_credits
title: Get credit balance
